reference.title: Campus Service Portal
reference.shortdesc: NC State's IT Service Portal contains guides for updating and managing outdated software.

section.title: NC State OIT Guides
section.p: NC State's Office of Information Technology frequently lists guides aimed for students, faculty, and staff, to understand how to update your software and devices, a long with why updating is important. The following table shows a few examples of guides OIT published.

strow.stentry: Update the Windows operating system on institutional or personal devices.
Microsoft Windows Software Updates and Patching
Explore the details and benefits of the latest Windows update.
Software Application Support Policy for the OIT Managed Desktop Service
Learn what the campus Office of Information Technology can assist with, what services are limited, and what services are not available.
Global Campus Jamf Blueprint for controlling minor Apple OS updates
Understand how campus schedules and approves minor updates to Apple devices.
